persistence.preRestartState: Reference: completed session with full transcript, plus a separate pending approval before restart (reference-behavior-matrix.md §4/§6.2). Cognate: J-G-persistence.test.ts creates and completes a session via a mock model provider against a temp COGNATE_HARNESS_HOME.
persistence.restart: Reference: process killed and dsh web relaunched against the same DSH_HOME. Cognate: app.stop() then startServer({port:0, home}) reopening the same SQLite file.
persistence.reconstructedState: Reference: completed session/transcript restored unchanged; pending approval does NOT survive (silently finalizes as Worked, empty). Cognate: sessions projection shows lastStatus=completed and correct title; workspaces record present; session.history returns 2 messages including the original text — all read back from the reopened store.
persistence.comparison: Completed-session persistence matches. Pending-approval persistence is an intentional, documented deviation: Cognate's continuation survives restart (durable by construction) where the reference finalizes it empty (J-D-approval.test.ts; DEVIATIONS.md 'Pending approvals survive a full server restart'). architecture-evidence.md criterion 6 independently confirms all four projections rebuild identically from the event log alone after projection/checkpoint state is deleted.

findings.description: RunContext.emit inside RunContext.step shifted emit:<n> counters on replay, allowing later-emit collisions.
findings.resolution: Repaired in packages/runtime-bun/src/executor.ts with conformance test 'a step's internal emits survive replay: no collision, no drop, correct order (D1)'.

findings.description: provider-openai-compatible advertised stream:true but did not map mid-stream abort/network failures to typed ModelProviderError.
findings.resolution: Repaired with two provider tests covering abort and HTTP-error mapping.

findings.description: HandlerContext had no progress/emit-like channel; streaming through a policy-gated, hot-swappable model.* capability was not expressible. This is the honest architectural gap the reconstruction test found.
findings.resolution: Added InvocationContext/HandlerContext.progress -> run.invocation.progress events (durable, ordered, replay-safe) as a domain-independent primitive, per operator decision 2026-09-26. Conformance test: 'a handler's progress calls are durable, ordered, and never repeated on replay (G1)'.

findings.type: framework finding, not fixed by design
findings.description: spawnSubagent (from @cognate/profile-harness) depends on a run_completion resolver living inside createHarness's closure; an app composing createRuntime directly cannot reuse it without copying the resolver.
findings.resolution: Not fixed on this branch — not needed because the reference's delegation is fire-and-forget; an earlier synchronous-await pass using spawnSubagent was itself a mismatch, corrected in f3fa09a. Candidate general fix (watchSubagentCompletions) remains open.

findings.description: invoker.ts's failureJson reduced any thrown error to {kind:'failed', message}, discarding structured fields like ModelProviderError.kind/status.
findings.resolution: Fixed in commit d93250d to preserve error.name and a JSON-safe details object; regression test 'records error name and details from thrown error'.
